ceridrak.label: Ceridrak
ceridrak.description: A creature with this trait is a memember of the Ceridrak Ancestry. These tall, lizardlike people typically have low-light vision. An ability with this trait can only be selected by Ceridrak. An item with this trait is used and created by Ceridrak.

kertizu.label: Kertizu
kertizu.description: A creature with this trait is a memember of the Kertizu Ancestry. These skull-faced caninines typically have natural weapons and low light vision. An ability with this trait can only be selected by Kertizu. An item with this trait is used and created by Kertizu.

executioner.label: Executioner
executioner.description: This weapon excels at delivering the finishing blow to weakened targets. This weapon deals +1 precision damage per weapon damage dice on a successful strike against a target that is Frightened, Enfeebled, Sickened, Drained or Clumsy.
